title: They Said Memes Were Harmless — We Found the Ones That Hurt: Decoding Jokes, Symbols, and Cultural References
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of the CROSS-ALIGN+ framework for detecting harmful memes (hate speech, misogyny, etc.) using Large Vision-Language Models. While it addresses social harms which have ethical implications, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or philosophical ethical systems.
